en.html:
At last, my consciousness and reality made contact.

The office. The small company where I worked.

Still bright outside the window. Full working hours. And here I was, conducting sleep with complete dedication. Deep sleep also, apparently.

The last time I had seen this scene—meaning, naturally, the moment before I fell asleep—felt years away. Such a thoroughly unreasonable feeling.

en.html:
Department Head"Leave it. Things at home are difficult, aren't they? Not much work today. You can go now."
Kageaki"But, sir—"
Department Head"Work yourself flat when there is no work, then collapse when there is work: where does that leave me?"
Kageaki"............"
Female Colleague"Exactly. For us salaried people, the body is the capital. Maintaining it is also company work."
Kageaki"...That is true."
Female Colleague"So my afternoon nap is also company work. Haan, now you understand. All this time I was working with my eyes closed. The shocking truth has finally come out."
Department Head"...See? With an employee like this, the company is still running. You can go without worrying."
Kageaki"Yes..."

en.html:
I put on the armor.

What—what power this was.

Every wild beast on earth would be left eating its dust. Violence beyond them all, here in my hands.

And so clean! So exhilarating!

Power that hated evil.

Those conceited fellows, tormenting weak people with their great strength. This was the power to crush them with something greater still.

You have violence? Very good. Here is more.

Justice itself!

Here, wearing a body!

俺は装甲を遂げた。
　何という――力か。

　地上のあらゆる野獣に後塵を拝さしめるであろう、
超越的暴力がここに存在する。
　しかも――清々しく爽快な力！

　これは悪を憎む力だ。
　<ruby>強力<rt>ごうりき</rt></ruby>を振るって力弱き人々を苦しめる、そんな自惚
れた奴輩を、更に上回る暴威でもって叩き潰してやる
ための力なのだ。
　まさに正義！
　その体現！

en.html:
Evil was right there.

The bandit warrior about to kill my foster mother!

Seeing me, he seemed to panic. Fool! Had he thought power was his private property?

Only he could hurt people with violence? Whatever he liked, whenever he liked? That was the arrangement in his head?

Now I would answer that arrogance.

Before the iron hammer of justice, evil's violence must shatter!

　自分だけが好き放題に暴力で人を害せるのだと信じ

　その傲慢にいま報いをやる。

　悪の暴力は必ず正義の鉄槌の前に散るのだ！
